description: LegalCompass Labour Authorities Database - India Employment & Labour

jurisdiction_rules.notes: For establishments under state jurisdiction, the relevant state Labour Commissioner / Labour Court applies. When jurisdiction cannot be determined from available facts, jurisdiction needs verification.

authorities.name: Chief Labour Commissioner (Central)
authorities.jurisdiction_description: Establishments in central sphere: railways, banking, insurance, mines, oil fields, ports, central government establishments, central PSUs, and inter-state establishments
authorities.address: Shram Shakti Bhawan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi - 110001
authorities.maps_query: Chief Labour Commissioner Central New Delhi
authorities.notes: Handles wage payment, industrial disputes, conciliation for central sphere establishments

authorities.name: Regional Labour Commissioner (Central) - Hyderabad

authorities.maps_query: Regional Labour Commissioner Central Hyderabad Kendriya Sadan

authorities.name: Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
authorities.jurisdiction_description: Provident fund, pension and insurance matters for establishments with 20 or more employees
authorities.address: Bhavishya Nidhi Bhawan, 14-Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi - 110066
authorities.maps_query: EPFO Head Office Bhavishya Nidhi Bhawan New Delhi
authorities.notes: For PF complaints use the EPFO Grievance portal: https://epfigms.gov.in/

authorities.name: Industrial Tribunal / Labour Court
authorities.jurisdiction_description: Adjudication of industrial disputes referred by appropriate government
authorities.address: Location depends on the relevant state / central government reference
authorities.notes: Industrial disputes may be referred to Labour Courts or Industrial Tribunals under the Industrial Relations Code, 2020. Exact court depends on the nature and category of dispute and the relevant appropriate government.

authorities.name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) / State Legal Services Authority (SALSA)
authorities.parent: Supreme Court of India / High Court
authorities.jurisdiction_description: Free legal aid for eligible workers and citizens across India
authorities.address: 12/11, Jam Nagar House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi - 110011 (NALSA HO). Contact your District Legal Services Authority for local assistance.
authorities.maps_query: NALSA National Legal Services Authority New Delhi
authorities.notes: Free legal aid to workers earning below prescribed income, SC/ST workers, women, and other eligible categories. Contact District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in your district.
